card.name: Month and year in event dates
card.fires_on: Month names and year digits inside calendar dates of news events, mostly 2010s dates, where a year or time span is about to complete. Also words like day or years in phrases about a period of time.

modes.label: Dates of events
modes.description: A month name or year digit within a dated news item, before the rest of the date.
modes.example: Apr 07, 2011 - Magnitude-7 quake hits Japan (Lead) -<< Jan>> 01, 201

modes.description: A time unit such as day or years in a phrase about a period.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning period or time span (such as 时期 and 期间), suggesting a time-period reading.
